title: Unit review quiz
subject: PSHE
unit: Spring 2: Who likes chocolate? Global trade, media and stereotyping
source: Seeded from pshe/y6 lesson 15 (Unit review quiz (pupil PDF))
intro: Covers lessons 10 to 15 of Who likes chocolate? Global trade, media and stereotyping. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: In the example chart, about how many times more is UK income than Ghana's?
questions.a: A) About 20 times. 48,000 ÷ 2,200 ≈ 22, so about 20 times.

questions.q: Cocoa arriving in the UK from Ghana is a UK ...
questions.a: A) import. Goods coming in are imports.

questions.q: Which choice reduces your footprint most?
questions.a: A) Turning off lights and taps. Saving energy and water reduces the footprint.

questions.q: Which is a cause of famine?
questions.a: A) Long drought. Drought destroys crops.
A) Helps two sides agree fairly. A mediator is neutral and fair.
